subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of an output device ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Printer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **Printer** is an example of an output device.
 
• Output devices are used to send data from a computer to another device or user.
 
• Other examples of output devices include monitors, speakers, and projectors.</l
